_comment: The animations /demos/animations/ shows, each loaded on a click from the site that made it. The talk's embeds come from data/present/talk.json; these are the rest worth showing a customer. Credit and licence as each site states them: the Ultimate Insider studio and ruv.sgit.ai, by Dinis Cruz and their agent teams, code Apache-2.0, text CC BY 4.0.

extra.title: The ABP gate, the original
extra.what: Eleven real actions fly at a gate twice: the default lets all through; with the behaviour policy, four are denied, two held for a person, five through, and receipts chain below.

extra.title: One action's journey
extra.what: Three actions, each through six stations: the ask, its role's behaviour policy, the row, the gate, the action or a named person, and a receipt in a hash chain.
extra.credit: A port of ruv.sgit.ai's journey, the Ultimate Insider studio

extra.title: The ABP, worked
extra.what: A coder's mandate compiled into rules, then real actions through them.
extra.credit: A port of ruv.sgit.ai's ABP slide, the Ultimate Insider studio

extra.title: The lethal trifecta
extra.what: Private data, untrusted content and a way out, as three switches: all on and a path opens; switch any one off and it closes.

extra.title: Five published ABP examples
extra.what: Five behaviour policies from abp.sgit.ai as small multiples: grant, mandate, excess, and what bounds it.

extra.title: A typical deployment, mapped
extra.what: One box on an architecture diagram, a CI job or a browser extension, opened into everything it reaches.

extra.title: The layers
extra.what: The hive, the mandate and the vault as three planes that build, then lie flat: many hands, a memory and a mandate.

extra.title: The city of vaults
extra.what: A street per branch, a floor per commit, the behaviour policy as the city wall with gates, receipts as streetlights.
